data.name: Pulchra
data.description:
Pulchra is an Outer Ring mercenary whose loyalty constantly fluctuates depending on who she deems the strongest. After several run-ins with the Sons of Calydon, she gained respect for the gang and began to reconsider her temporary allegiance with The Vanquishers. After Caesar King rose to power as Overlord, Pulchra finally decided to join the Sons of Calydon, becoming an intel gatherer for the gang.

Though a seemingly loyal member of the gang, Pulchra merely tolerates each of the members, especially Burnice White, whose overly-affectionate personality and semi-obliviousness to common courtesy clashes greatly with Pulchra's own personality.

In combat, Pulchra fights with a pair of "Bladeguns" (which appear as revolvers with blades on the grip) and an array of gadgets, including stun grenades, explosives and reflex-enhancing tonics. Pulchra wears a special respirator mask that blocks out Ether particles and pollen, whilst also protecting her from the gazes of others, she rarely takes off this mask, even wearing it around New Eridu.

Outer-Ring born, Pulchra Fellini was raised in one of the poorest towns in the wilds. Her only friend was a fellow Thiren named Milena, who she'd played with often. Their most played game was pretending they lived in the city, which included roleplaying as waiters and customers. The two Thiren shared a dream of one day living in the city and truly being the people they pretended to be, but living in the Outer-Ring and having notable Ether Aptitudes meant the best career for them was becoming mercenaries. Despite not knowing their Ether Aptitude levels, both Pulchra and Melina became mercenaries, after a while Melina suggested that she and Pulchra should start their own group and swiftly put Pulchra in charge, using her bank account for it.

Sometime after forming the group, Pulchra realized that the goods a client entrusted them with have gone missing, alongside all the money in the account. Confronting Milena about this, the fellow mercenary revealed she took the funds in order to start a new life in the city, before knocking her out. Though she spared Pulchra's life, she left her with a massive debt that she decided to run from, leaving others to pay the price for their trust.

Pulchra went back to being another mercenary for hire, only thinking about herself and her personal gain over bonds and trust.
